_comment: Declarative AutoForm layout for the TTTR Split / Convert tool. Input/Output, Split-options and Batch are rearrangeable dock panels whose arrangement is remembered across sessions (persist); the Convert/Split run bar stays fixed below the docks. File pickers, run/progress bar and batch list are custom sections (drag-drop + tttrlib).

sections.title: Split / Convert
sections.description: Convert a TTTR file to another format or split it into several files.

sections.title: Input / Output
sections.description: Input and output file and format.
Choose the input file and the output folder.

sections.label: Input format
sections.description: Force an input container type, or Auto to detect it from the file.

sections.label: Output format
sections.description: Container format written to disk; differs from input ⇒ transcode.

sections.title: Split options
sections.description: Photons per file, micro-time binning and what to keep.

sections.label: Photons/file
sections.description: Photons per output file (×1000) when 'Split into files' is on.

sections.label: µ-time binning
sections.description: Micro-time binning factor (clamped to ≥8 for SPC containers).
Split into files, reset macro times and keep the original.

items.label: Split into files
items.description: Split into chunks of N photons; off = a single output file.

items.label: Reset macro times
items.description: Macro times of each output file restart at zero.

items.label: Keep original
items.description: Leave the source file in place (off = delete after writing).

sections.title: Batch
sections.description: Process many files with the options above; folders are scanned recursively for .ptu.
Files queued for the batch run.
Write each result next to its source file.
sections.label: Use file's parent as output folder
